sourceNotes: Flock Fantasy's Top 100 is the cross-position anchor; its August 24 WR Top 50 overrides the older WR order, and dated riser/faller signals are applied only after current-report verification (2026-08-25T09:00:00-04:00).
The final NYFL rank is recalculated for 12 teams, half-PPR scoring, one FLEX and seven bench spots using an 82% market/opinion score and an 18% league-specific value-over-replacement score.
Official Boris Chen position and Top 200 CSV exports are imported directly. His model clusters FantasyPros expert averages with a Gaussian mixture model.

Injury context is merged from ESPN status data and dated repository overrides (2026-08-31T14:00:00-05:00); live rank, live tier, season projection, and expected weekly points reflect the availability adjustment.
ESPN does not publish formal API documentation for its live-draft feed. The updater preserves the last good snapshot if a source becomes unavailable.
Likes, avoids, keepers, notes, drafted players, and round plans live in browser storage and are never overwritten by data refreshes.
Repository-backed confirmed keepers and expert watchlist seeds live in separate public/data JSON files, so the daily player refresh does not overwrite them.

Projected fantasy points are recalculated from ESPN raw stat projections using NYFL scoring: half-PPR, four-point passing touchdowns, distance-based field goals, and the league's points- and yards-allowed D/ST bands.

Durability risk is a relative 0–100 index using 2021–2024 nflverse injury-report burden and recurrence, current status, age/experience, projected workload, and position baseline. It is not a probability or medical diagnosis.

The shared team model combines 2026 Sharp O-line projections, DraftSharks implied offense, and 2025 nflverse sack/QB-hit avoidance; historical Pearson correlations are recalculated from the underlying 32-team sample.
